name: Potassium
note: Hemolysis can falsely raise potassium. Check the sample, and consider an ECG if the result is unexpected.

name: Anion gap
note: The normal range depends on the assay. ABIM lists 7 to 13.

name: Glucose, plasma (fasting)
note: ABIM range is for fasting plasma glucose.

name: Hemoglobin A1c
note: Reference range only. Diagnostic cut-offs and treatment targets are separate.

name: Troponin I, high-sensitivity
note: Assay-specific. Interpret with symptoms, ECG and serial values.

name: Troponin T, high-sensitivity
note: Assay-specific. Interpret with symptoms, ECG and serial values.

name: Troponin I, conventional
note: Conventional assay limits are laboratory-specific. Interpret with symptoms, ECG and serial values.

name: HDL cholesterol
note: ABIM lists low HDL as below 50 mg/dL in women and below 40 mg/dL in men.
